question: Does the SHIPPED product counter-probe planner (product/query/adversarial_retrieval.py at accepted product head 44330212, ADVERSARIAL_RETRIEVAL_VERSION adversarial_retrieval/3) reproduce, byte-for-byte on the pinned recorded 14-bundle population, the probe queries and topic anchors that the ACCEPTED offline repair verification (run 39687372110, verdict REPAIR_VERIFIED_ON_RECORDED_BYTES) produced by synthetically applying remedy (a)?
why_this_is_the_ordered_item: Factory direction v62 evaluation ordered item (1): stand ready for remedy (a) to land in the product lane, then re-freeze the repair verification against the NEW shipped planner under a NEW run id. Remedy (a) HAS landed (product cycle 39752638579; planner sha drift 57b6a6f9... -> 9764a37e...; strip_redaction_placeholders present at line 285 of the shipped planner). The accepted repair verification is pinned pre-remedy by design (its freeze record states: 'If the product lane lands remedy (a), the product pins drift by design and a NEW freeze under a NEW run id verifies the shipped planner'), so this is that NEW freeze. It is the retrieval/counter-authority falsification benchmark for the landed fix, and it is the smallest executable artifact that can falsify whether the fix the product shipped is the fix evaluation verified.
hypothesis: For every one of the 14 recorded fixture bundles, the shipped planner's plan_adversarial_queries(query, answer_prose) issues probe queries byte-for-byte equal to the accepted repair-verification record's FIXED arm (fixed_probe_queries), and its topic anchor (first 4 tokens of the probe) equals the accepted FIXED anchor; consequently the four accepted repair gates re-expressed on shipped bytes (G1s anchor clean, G2s formerly-contaminated anchors topical, G3s clean bundles unperturbed vs accepted BASELINE, G4s shipped==accepted FIXED) all hold.
baseline: The accepted offline repair verification run 39687372110 (record sha256 53b3fc9c71c81bb238a000eadde5bf3bacd7d37349fa1a43017d5527e651e340), whose per-bundle BASELINE and FIXED arms are the comparison of record. The accepted anchor falsifier run 39674402905 (record sha256 87c059f6c980fc000fa7151889a59f42900c33d6d29c4fd2391eec7010911048) is the upstream source of the population and the de-redacted counterfactual anchors.

population.definition: the same 14 recorded bundles with non-empty provenance.adversarial_retrieval.probes on the accepted product mount /tmp/lex_accepted/product, across packets 38838116453, 38839347028, 39275520116, 39319405429, rebuilt-39027045675
population.note: the recorded probe queries inside the bundles were produced by the PRE-remedy planner and are the BASELINE arm; the bundles themselves are frozen evidence and are never regenerated or edited by this instrument

gates.G1s_shipped_anchor_clean: on every one of the 14 bundles the shipped planner's topic anchor contains no token the shipped answer_key_terms extracts from the accepted redaction placeholder (expected tokens: citation, removed, retrieved)
gates.G2s_formerly_contaminated_regain_topical: on each of the 2 bundles whose accepted BASELINE anchor was placeholder-contaminated (39275520116 de-kapitalverletzung, 39319405429 de-kapitalverletzung), the shipped anchor shares at least one content term (shipped content_terms pool rule) with the question it attacks
gates.G3s_clean_bundles_unperturbed: on each of the 12 bundles whose accepted BASELINE anchor was clean, the shipped probe queries equal the accepted BASELINE probe queries byte-for-byte (for clean bundles accepted FIXED == accepted BASELINE, so this is also the no-op requirement)
gates.G4s_shipped_matches_accepted_fixed: on all 14 bundles, the shipped probe queries equal the accepted repair-verification record's FIXED probe queries byte-for-byte AND the shipped anchor equals the accepted FIXED anchor

controls.C1s_fixture_integrity: the accepted repair-verification record re-hashes to its pin AND its verdict is REPAIR_VERIFIED_ON_RECORDED_BYTES
controls.C2s_placeholder_preconditions_intact: the accepted REDACTION_PLACEHOLDER constant is still exactly '[citation removed: not in retrieved set]' in the shipped source_packing, and the shipped answer_key_terms applied to the placeholder alone still derives exactly the token class {citation, removed, retrieved}
controls.C3s_defect_was_real: the accepted repair-verification record contains at least one baseline-contaminated row (expected exactly 2)
controls.C4s_planted_preremedy_extractor_detects_: a PRE-REMEDY-EMULATED key-term extractor (identical ranking/filters but WITHOUT the placeholder strip, computed locally from the shipped tokenize + _ANSWER_STOP which remedy (a) did not change) must reproduce the placeholder-contaminated anchor on exactly the 2 formerly-contaminated bundles and stay clean on the other 12 - this is the planted-divergence control proving the gate battery can detect the defect class it protects against
controls.C5s_zero_network: the instrument performs zero network calls; the product loader path is offline module loading and file reads only

non_vacuity_disclosure: C4s is the non-vacuity control of this instrument. Without it, a shipped tree whose extractor derived no tokens at all would trivially pass G1s. With it, the control battery must observe the pre-remedy defect signature on the known-contaminated bundles before any G1s pass is claimed.

exit_code_contract.0: SHIPPED_PLANNER_MATCHES_VERIFIED_REMEDY - every gate passes and every control holds
exit_code_contract.1: SHIPPED_PLANNER_DIVERGES_FROM_VERIFIED_REMEDY - at least one gate fails on shipped bytes; this FALSIFIES the landed fix as the verified fix (or as a full equivalent of it on this population)
exit_code_contract.2: ENVIRONMENT_OR_VACUOUS - pin drift, loader failure, empty population or a failed control; exit 2 is NEVER a product verdict and NEVER a landing verdict

success_rule: verdict SHIPPED_PLANNER_MATCHES_VERIFIED_REMEDY with exit 0 requires all four gates passing AND all five controls holding AND pins re-hashing clean both before and after execution.
falsification_rule: any single bundle where shipped probe queries != accepted FIXED probe queries, or any G1s/G2s/G3s failure, yields verdict SHIPPED_PLANNER_DIVERGES_FROM_VERIFIED_REMEDY with exit 1 and the failing bundles are published in full.
claim_ceiling: This instrument establishes exactly one thing: whether the SHIPPED planner at the pinned product head reproduces, byte-for-byte on the pinned recorded 14-bundle population, the probe queries and anchors that the accepted offline repair verification verified synthetically. It is NOT a counter-authority RECALL measurement (no probe is executed against OpenCaseLaw; network_calls=0); it is NOT a re-score of the mapping-free counter_authority_surface gates (the V3 packet-of-record bytes stay frozen with 0 issued counter rows and the ordered re-score awaits REGENERATED bundles, which do not exist because no accepted serve recommendation exists); it is NOT a label or geometry bar claim (both stay REPORTED-ONLY and unmet); it is NOT a serve recommendation and lifts no DO-NOT-SERVE order; admission stays fail-closed; human_gate_ready, machine_gate_ready, packet_admitted, ready_for_owner_session and owner_decision_required stay false. It re-derives no threshold, bar, rubric or verdict contract; the frozen RULES_LABEL/RULES_GEOMETRY/VERDICT_CONTRACT hashes are not consumed by this instrument and are not re-tuned. It runs no obsolete universal-174k benchmark.

inputs_pinned.pin_drift_disclosure: the pre-remedy planner pin is EXPECTED to drift and is recorded for provenance only; the new planner pin above is the pin of record for this run. Pin drift is the documented fail-closed design of the accepted freeze, not a defect.

determinism: pure offline computation from frozen bytes; no RNG; no threshold; no projection constant
what_will_NOT_be_concluded: that counter-authority recall improved (no probe executes)
that the mapping-free counter_authority_surface gates now pass (V3 bytes are frozen pre-remedy)
that any frozen bar is met
that any packet may be served or admitted
that the map helps a jurist (human product gate question)
